name: Morpholine
description: Morpholine (CAS 110-91-8 ) is a cyclic amine and ether used across industrial chemistry as a corrosion inhibitor, chemical intermediate, and curing agent. Its dual amine-ether functionality makes it a building block for a broad range of downstream synthesis applications. In steam boiler and water treatment systems, morpholine is dosed to neutralize carbonic acid and suppress corrosion in condensate return lines. It serves as a well-established alternative to volatile amines in these environments. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as a synthetic intermediate in the production of active ingredients, where its secondary amine group enables targeted derivatization. This versatility is critical for complex chemical synthesis. In rubber and polymer processing, morpholine-based accelerators and crosslinkers improve cure rates and mechanical performance in finished elastomer products. These additives are essential for high-performance industrial rubber goods. Metalworking fluid formulators incorporate morpholine as a pH buffer and biocide component to extend fluid service life. This helps control microbial growth in demanding cutting and grinding operations across the manufacturing sector. Morpholine is supplied as a clear liquid in standard drum, IBC, and bulk tanker quantities. Technical grade is the primary commercial form, with high-purity grades available for specialized pharmaceutical synthesis applications. Buyers should confirm purity specifications and water content when sourcing for API intermediate use.
